headline: Stryker has agreed to invest about 400 million dollars in surgical robot maker CMR Surgical and to sell its Versius robot in the US, with an option to buy the company, pending regulatory approval.
score_reason: Fresh and clearly reported deal, but still subject to regulatory approval.
importance_line: Hospitals and surgeons in the US gain a new route to a soft-tissue surgical robot, but the deal is not yet approved and the buyout is only an option.
summary: BioXconomy reports that Stryker, a large US medical technology company, will invest about 400 million dollars in CMR Surgical, maker of the Versius soft-tissue surgical robot, and become its exclusive US sales agent. Stryker also gets an option to buy CMR outright, and the whole agreement still needs regulatory approval before it closes.
notes: Funding and sales deal, not a machine in action.
